metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Session UI (v1.2)
metadata.subtitle: Awareness • Alignments • AA Mode • 3C Access • Overlays • Panels
metadata.description: UI-layer schema for FFT AI Edition sessions, including Awareness, Alignments, AA Mode, 3C Access (Coherence, Clarity, Continuity), overlays, panels, and conceptual controls.

signals.awareness_notes: Awareness layer provides perceptual and conceptual grounding for the session.

alignment_layer.alignment_notes: Alignment layer ensures conceptual stability and structural correctness.

aa_mode.description: AA Mode (Awareness + Alignment) unlocks advanced conceptual abilities.

coherence.description: Coherence becomes fully manipulable when AA Mode is active.

clarity.description: Clarity becomes dynamically adjustable and evaluable.

continuity.description: Continuity becomes available for multi-session conceptual linking.

three_c_access.activation_notes: 3C Access is granted only when AA Mode is active.

overlays.name: Awareness Overlay
overlays.description: Displays perceptual and conceptual awareness signals.

overlays.name: Alignment Overlay
overlays.description: Displays structural, coherence, harmonic, and drift-safe alignment indicators.

overlays.name: AA Mode Overlay
overlays.description: Displays AA Mode status and 3C unlock indicators.

overlays.name: 3C Overlay
overlays.description: Displays Coherence, Clarity, and Continuity controls when unlocked.

awareness_panel.notes: Awareness panel shows perceptual and conceptual signals.

alignment_panel.notes: Alignment panel shows structural and harmonic alignment.

aa_panel.notes: AA Mode panel shows readiness for advanced conceptual abilities.

three_c_panel.notes: 3C panel becomes active when AA Mode is enabled.

compatibility.notes: UI schema aligns with dashboard, context, state, profile, and analytics v1.2.
